rule: Fiscal years July 1 to June 30, by each activity's first date. A row counts only in the earliest report year of its (jurisdiction, unit category, date, tracking ID) and (jurisdiction, unit category, date, APN) keys. Rows of one report identical in every column count once. A row dated before its own report year does not count when an earlier report lists the same tracking ID and units, on one row in each report, under a date in the same or an earlier fiscal year, whatever the unit category; for a single unit, the two rows' APNs must match or one must be missing. A row dated January to June of the year after its report counts only when it has a tracking ID or APN, the jurisdiction filed the next report, and that report lists neither identifier for the same activity. Report years are years with at least one Table A2 row; a fiscal year is full when both of its calendar years are reported.
